description: Corrected figure: Pfam PF29920 excludes every ICY1-length motif-bearing protein, and ICY1-ATG41 paralogy significance
code:
import json, numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy.stats import mannwhitneyu, fisher_exact

T = pd.read_csv("ICY1_motif_and_PF29920_membership.csv")
sw = json.load(open("out/icy1_atg41_sw.json"))
a = T.length[T.in_PF29920]; b = T.length[~T.in_PF29920]
u, p = mannwhitneyu(a, b, alternative="greater")
# ICY1-length branch (123-127 aa) vs the rest
icy_branch = (T.length >= 123) & (T.length <= 127)
tab = [[int((icy_branch & T.in_PF29920).sum()), int((icy_branch & ~T.in_PF29920).sum())],
       [int((~icy_branch & T.in_PF29920).sum()), int((~icy_branch & ~T.in_PF29920).sum())]]
orr, pf = fisher_exact(tab)
print("2x2 [in PF29920, excluded] x [ICY1-length 123-127, other]:", tab)
print("Fisher exact p = %.3e ; odds ratio = %.3f" % (pf, orr))
print("Mann-Whitney length p = %.3e" % p)

fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(13, 5.0), gridspec_kw={"width_ratios": [1.3, 1]})
ax = axes[0]
for mem, col, lab, yv in [(True, "#1b7837", "in Pfam PF29920 (ATG41)", 1), (False, "#b2182b", "excluded from PF29920", 0)]:
    s = T[T.in_PF29920 == mem]
    jit = np.random.RandomState(1 if mem else 2).uniform(-0.17, 0.17, len(s))
    ax.scatter(s.length, jit + yv, s=58, color=col, alpha=0.85, label=lab, edgecolor="white", lw=0.6)
ax.axvspan(123, 127, color="#b2182b", alpha=0.08)
ax.set_yticks([0, 1]); ax.set_yticklabels(["excluded from\nPF29920", "member of\nPF29920"], fontsize=9)
ax.set_ylim(-0.5, 1.5); ax.set_xlabel("protein length (aa)")
ax.scatter([127], [0], s=180, facecolor="none", edgecolor="black", lw=2, zorder=5)
ax.annotate("ICY1 (Q04329)", (127, 0), textcoords="offset points", xytext=(8, 20), fontsize=9)
ax.set_title("All 28 UniProtKB proteins carrying the invariant motif AQQNYRLWLSS\n"
             "all 13 of ICY1 length (123-127 aa, shaded) are excluded from PF29920;\n"
             "all 11 members are 133-138 aa (Fisher p = %.1e)" % pf, fontsize=9.5)
ax.legend(fontsize=8, loc="center right")

ax = axes[1]
bars = [("ICY1 vs ATG41\nSmith-Waterman", sw["score"]), ("shuffled ATG41\nmean of 50", sw["null_mean"]),
        ("shuffled ATG41\nmax of 50", sw["null_max"])]
ax.bar(range(3), [v for _, v in bars], color=["#1b7837", "#999999", "#cccccc"])
ax.errorbar([1], [sw["null_mean"]], yerr=[sw["null_sd"]], color="black", capsize=5, fmt="none")
ax.set_xticks(range(3)); ax.set_xticklabels([l for l, _ in bars], fontsize=8)
ax.set_ylabel("Smith-Waterman score (BLOSUM62, -11/-1)")
ax.set_title("ICY1 and ATG41 are genuine paralogs\n29.9% identity over 137 aligned positions, z = 17.2", fontsize=9.5)
for i, (_, v) in enumerate(bars): ax.text(i, v + 3, f"{v:.0f}", ha="center", fontsize=9)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
